prompt:
Create a beautiful but visually restrained 320x180 pixel art background for the Mars Crafts rover engineering workshop interface.

Show the interior of a compact industrial space research workshop, with dark blue-gray metallic wall panels, a few organized scientific tools, subtle equipment shelves, small technical consoles, restrained cyan status lights, white-gray machinery and small industrial orange accents.

Match the existing Mars Crafts laboratory tileset and industrial UI design.

Use authentic 16-bit Game Boy Advance pixel art, crisp square pixels, layered metallic materials and limited colors.

Keep the main interface areas dark, clean and low contrast so separate rover preview images, buttons, equipment icons and dynamic resource statistics remain clearly readable.

Create a background illustration rather than a playable top-down map.

No rover, no characters, no UI panels, no buttons, no text, no numbers, no bright distracting lights, no realistic gradients.

Wide 16:9 composition.
